data.description:
src/app/page.tsx Section 2 (lines 40-80): the right cell holds /images/home/software-split.riso.1.png in a relative parent with <Image fill object-cover />. The section is grid h-screen grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2.

On desktop the image is half a viewport wide and full-height — close enough to square. On mobile (single column) the section is still h-screen, so each row gets ~50vh tall while spanning 100vw — a wide-and-short rectangle. The image then object-cover crops to fit, looking 'shrunken / shorter'.

Fix: on mobile the image cell should be aspect-square (or at minimum match the desktop aspect ratio). Likely change the section from h-screen to h-auto on mobile, or give the image cell aspect-square md:aspect-auto md:h-full.
data.title: Mobile: 'Software Development + AI Research' image squishes — should stay square

data.body: Reported issue (2026-04-29): software home photo (Section 2 'Software Development + AI Research') still renders shorter than square on mobile.

Reviewed PR #96 with fresh context. Verified: (1) diff matches plan exactly — two CSS-only edits in src/app/page.tsx Section 2: section className changed from 'grid h-screen grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2' to 'grid grid-cols-1 md:h-screen md:grid-cols-2', and image cell wrapper changed from 'relative overflow-hidden' to 'relative aspect-square overflow-hidden md:aspect-auto md:h-full'. (2) Scope clean — only the planned file/lines touched, no scope creep. (3) pnpm lint passes locally (only pre-existing warnings unrelated to this change). (4) pnpm build succeeds locally. (5) Vercel CI checks pass. Acceptance criteria 1-2 are visual and not directly verifiable from a code review, but the CSS change is the textbook fix for the diagnosed root cause (h-screen + grid-cols-1 forcing 100vw × 50vh image cell on mobile) and aligns precisely with the plan's reasoning. Criteria 3-4 verified. PASS — no rework needed.
